study_identification_part.si_4_title: Contrasting Case-Control and Normative Reference Approaches to Capture Clinically Relevant Structural Brain Abnormalities in Patients With First-Episode Psychosis Who Are Antipsychotic Naive

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: SINGLE-SITE: Data were collected at a single site, the University of Alabama at Birmingham, including 98 patients with first-episode psychosis and 92 healthy controls. None (Pre-Trained NM): A pre-trained normative reference model (n = 58,836) from the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit and BrainCharts (Rutherford et al., 2022) was used to generate individual deviations. The healthy controls from the local site were used for site-specific calibration of the pre-trained model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We recruited patients with FEP from clinical sites at the University of Alabama at Birmingham and controls via advertisements" ... "We quantified individual deviations for each region (and averaged those for bilateral regions) based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits" ... "We used control data to calibrate normative curves."

answer.SINGLE-SITE (UAB): case-control comparison, normative model calibration (healthy controls), and clinical research (FEP patients)

answer.None (Pre-Trained NM): pre-trained normative reference model (n = 58,836) for computing individual deviations via BrainCharts

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The local University of Alabama at Birmingham site provided both the patient sample (98 FEP) for clinical application and the healthy control sample (92 HC) for two purposes: (1) case-control contrasts and (2) calibration of the pre-trained normative model to the local site/scanner. The pre-trained normative model (n = 58,836) from Rutherford et al. 2022 / BrainCharts was used as the reference to compute z-score deviations for each individual.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Volumes and deviations were quantified in 98 patients with FEP, and data from 92 controls were used as comparison for case-control contrasts and reference curve calibration." ... "based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits" ... "To transfer the normative models to new sites, healthy controls from the new data set are used to learn site effects."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Remiszewski2022.pdf.md: Results, L17; Methods, L59; Figure 1 caption, L141-142

model-1.model-name: BrainCharts pre-trained normative model (Rutherford et al., 2022)

answer.note: The pre-trained normative model was based on 58,836 individuals. Train/test split details are not reported in this paper (they are in the original BrainCharts publication, Rutherford et al. 2022). Additionally, 92 local healthy controls were used for site-specific calibration of this pre-trained model but were not part of the original normative model training.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used a pre-trained normative reference model built on 58,836 individuals from the BrainCharts project. The local site contributed 92 healthy controls for calibration purposes only. The internal train/test split of the 58,836 sample is not described in this paper.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits" ... "data from 92 controls were used as comparison for case-control contrasts and reference curve calibration"

answer.note: Age statistics for the pre-trained BrainCharts normative model (n = 58,836) are not reported in this paper; they are available in the original publication (Rutherford et al., 2022, eLife). For the local calibration/application sample: all participants (N = 190) mean (SD) = 23.7 (5.5) years; HC (n = 92) mean (SD) = 23.90 (5.44) years; FEP (n = 98) mean (SD) = 23.42 (5.67) years.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The pre-trained normative model age information is not provided in this paper. The local sample demographics are: HC mean age 23.90 (SD 5.44) years and FEP mean age 23.42 (SD 5.67) years, with no significant difference between groups (t = 0.79, P = .55). Age range of local sample is not explicitly reported.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Of 190 included participants, 111 (58.4%) were male, and the mean (SD) age was 23.7 (5.5) years." ... Table: "Age, mean (SD), y: 23.42 (5.67) [FEP] ... 23.90 (5.44) [HCs]"

answer.note: Sex distribution for the pre-trained BrainCharts normative model (n = 58,836) is not reported in this paper. For the local calibration sample: HC (n = 92): Male 51 (55.4%), Female 41 (44.6%). For FEP (n = 98): Male 60 (61.2%), Female 38 (38.8%). Overall (N = 190): Male 111 (58.4%), Female 79 (41.6%).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex information for the pre-trained normative model is not available in this paper. The local healthy controls used for calibration had 51 males (55.4%) and 41 females (44.6%). Overall sample sex: 111 male (58.4%), 79 female (41.6%).
